title: Choose Your Hard
caption: Quitting sin is hard. Hearing 'Depart from me' will be harder. Choose your hard.

title: Not Religious
caption: I am not religious... I just follow Jesus.

title: Ready To Be Corrected
caption: The Bible is offensive to those who aren't ready to be corrected.

title: Not The Stars
caption: Zodiac signs try to define you. But God says that's His job, not the stars.

title: Bible Thumper
caption: When I first came to God, I didn't want to be a Bible thumper. Now look at me... A Bible thumper 😂

title: Another Level Of Strength
caption: Having to let go of someone you love to obey God is another level of strength.

title: World Record
caption: Jesus holds the world record for most lives saved...

title: Knowing Sin Isn't Safety
caption: Solomon wrote Proverbs and still fell to the very sins he described. Knowing sin does not mean you are safe from it.

title: Until You Find Treasure
caption: Reading the Bible scratches the surface. Studying the Bible digs until you find treasure.

title: They Read You
caption: Non-believers don't read the Bible, but they read you, so be a reflection of Christ everywhere you go.

title: Life Feels Off
caption: Anybody else notice how life feels off after just a few days of not opening your Bible?

title: You Do Have Time
caption: "I don't have time to read the Bible." Yes, you do. Go to bed 30 minutes earlier. Wake up 30 minutes earlier. That's 30 minutes of peace with God that can change your whole day.

title: Be Honest
caption: Be honest, when was the last time you opened your bible 👀

title: 20 Minutes
caption: I don't know who needs to hear this... But spending 20 minutes in your Bible might do more for your peace than 2 hours on your phone.

title: Uncomfortable Truth
caption: Uncomfortable truth: The world isn't tired of Jesus. They're tired of Christians who don't look like Him.

title: It's Easy To Wear A Cross
caption: IT'S EASY TO WEAR A CROSS AROUND YOUR NECK IT'S HARDER TO CARRY ONE ON YOUR BACK.

title: Jesus Is My Everything
caption: Jesus is my Peace. Jesus is my Strength. Jesus is my Savior. Jesus is my Redeemer. Jesus is my Shepherd. Jesus is my Refuge. Jesus is my Hope. Jesus is my Provider. Jesus is my Lord. Jesus is my Everything.

title: Closed Bibles
caption: You cannot win a spiritual warfare with closed Bibles.

title: Give Him The Gratitude
caption: Jesus woke us all up this morning give him all the gratitude 🙌

title: 7 Signs God Is Answering You
caption: 7 Signs God Is Answering You 🕊 You suddenly have peace 🚪 Unexpected doors open 🚫 Wrong doors keep closing 📖 Scripture feels personal 👥 God sends the right people ⏳ Waiting is strengthening you 🙌 Looking back... you realize He already answered

title: Too Seriously
caption: I'd rather hear the world say, "He is taking this Jesus thing too seriously" than to hear "Depart from me, I never knew you."

title: Live By It
caption: The Bible isn't just for quoting, you have to live by it...

title: Become A Better Version Of Yourself
caption: God. Go ghost. Gym. Small circle. Make more money. Accept the past. Become a better version of yourself.

title: Stop Trying To Find Yourself
caption: Instead of trying to find yourself. Open up the Bible & find God. Then you'll truly know who you are. Your identity is found in God.

title: Not Your Job
caption: Your job isn't to change people. Your job is to tell them about Jesus. The Holy Spirit handles the rest.

title: Very Expensive
caption: The price you pay for ignoring the Holy Spirit is very expensive.

title: The Louder The World Gets
caption: The longer I stay away from my Bible, the louder the world gets.

title: Offend Your Flesh
caption: The Bible is supposed to offend your flesh.

title: Not By Accident
caption: You don't accidentally grow closer to God. You do it by spending time with Him.

title: Job 8:7
caption: "And though you started with little, you will end with much." - Job 8:7

title: If God Had Threads
caption: Proverbs feels like what God would post if He had a Threads account...

title: Kill Your Flesh
caption: I'm a firm believer that if you are Christian, you MUST WORKOUT. Physical discipline is key in helping to kill your flesh.

title: Like God Sent You
caption: Someone told me, "Walk into every room like God sent you." That one sentence changed how I move.

title: God's Pen
caption: Don't grab the pen out of God's hand. The story He writes will always be better than the one you would've written.

title: Stop Venting
caption: Stop venting to people who can't fix it. Take it to God.

title: Christ Won't
caption: Christians will disappoint you. Pastors will disappoint you. Churches will disappoint you. Christ won’t.
